[[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] and the [[Halloween 2026 Live Events|Halloween 2026 Live Event]]. It is a stronger version of the [[Mandrake]], boasting higher health, walking faster and summoning in stronger enemies. Upon death, it spawns in two [[Elite Mystery|Elite Mysteries]], one [[Blighted]] and three [[Bloated]] and [[Nimble]] [[Mandrake]]s. ==Logbook Description== "''The Nightshade are creatures that were once Odds, but the Odd had died in some way. If the corpse was lucky enough to have fallen onto the flora of the Void, they were then consumed by the overgrowth and turned into a Nightshade. It’s up for debate whether you could call them living, as the flowers have completely set root throughout their entire bodies, but it wouldn’t be far-fetched to say they are being controlled by it. The flowers throughout the Void sometimes have sentience, as flora finds nutrients through corpses as they decompose. Sometimes, a Nightshade will wander. Not to anything specific. It just drifts to wherever the flowers feel like going that day.''" ==Appearance== The '''Nightshade''' is a bush primarily containing flowers. On top of the bush, there are multiple purple crystals. Under the bush, two legs can be seen. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Juggernaut]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Engineer]] or [[Ranger]] can be used to take this down. **As it summons in multiple enemies on death, a lot of which also have some sort of summoning ability, towers with some AOE capabilities like the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Engineer]] can be especially useful. **Support towers like the [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Medic]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NightshadeIconIG.png|'''Nightshade''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Nightshade''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Nightshade''' added. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **[[Elite Mystery]] spawns decreased from 3 to 2. **Now summons one [[Blighted]] on death. {{Hardcore|[[Unknown Small]] & [[Elite Void Rusher]]|Wave 34|Nightshade|Wave 35|[[Void Keeper]]|Wave 36}} {{Voidcore|[[Soul]] & [[Elite Soul]]|Wave 41|[[Void Trickster]] & Nightshade|Wave 42|[[Vindicator]]|Wave 43}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
